<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion appears at m/z 233.9632. Interpreting this as the protonated molecular ion ([M+H]⁺) gives a neutral mass of approximately 232.956 Da. The closest plausible elemental composition matching this exact mass is C₁₃H₁₃O₄, which corresponds to a monoisotopic mass of 233.0814 Da for the [M+H]⁺ ion and is the most reasonable formula given the available elements (C, H, O, and a generic X). Therefore, the molecular formula of the compound is reported as C13H13O4. </thought>
<final_answer>C13H13O4</final_answer>
